decisions.story_title: 40% of MCP servers lack authentication, and OAuth implementations all have security flaws
decisions.reason: Measurement study of ~8,000 remote MCP servers found 40.55% have no auth at all. Every OAuth-enabled server had at least one flaw. Over 300 CVEs filed against MCP infrastructure. Real security research with concrete numbers affecting AI agent infrastructure.
Generic weekly vulnerability summary roundups do not constitute actionable security events. The store already has vulnerability summary stories from prior weeks that add little value.
LOLRMM tool listing announcement for Lavawall. Not a security event, just a tool being added to a catalog.

decisions.story_title: BigCommerce merchant data breach via compromised third-party Ribon app credentials
decisions.reason: Confirmed credential compromise on Ribon/Be A Part Of apps led to malicious script injection into BigCommerce stores. Shopper data (names, emails, phones, addresses) exposed for Sep 13-17. Master of Malt confirmed affected. Real breach with specific timeline, affected parties, and data types.
Tech tutorial for repurposing a rooted Android phone as an NFC authenticator. Not a security event.
